navy.purpose: Every live action and every rubric: buttons, links, the running head, list markers, the selected control, the focus ring, and the correct-answer fill.

navy-dark.purpose: The third triptych stroke and any navy that must sit against navy.

navy-tint.purpose: The only tonal step in the system: row and button hover, the body of a select field.

gold.purpose: Rules and borders only. The 2px frame on a wrong answer, the gauge fill, the dhow's hull, the margin tie. Never set as text on the page ground.

gold-tint.purpose: The wash behind a wrong answer — the one place a signal colour becomes a fill.

bg.purpose: The ground of every surface, the fixed colophon included.

card.purpose: Reserved for inset contexts; no surface is filled with it today.

ink-soft.purpose: Secondary apparatus: descriptions, verdict buttons at rest, the result line.

ink-faint.purpose: The quietest register: the isnad chain, source credits, captions, disabled text. Both values clear WCAG AA against their ground.

on-navy.purpose: Text laid on a navy fill. It flips in dark mode because navy itself becomes light there.

switch-track.purpose: The theme toggle's track, one step away from the ground so the knob reads.

switch-ink.purpose: The sun or moon inside the knob.

display.purpose: The one opening heading per screen; Literata 500, text-wrap: balance.

headline.purpose: Screen title inside a flow of blocks.

title.purpose: Subheadings and the result line's scale partner.

lede.purpose: Opening set paragraph, Literata 300, text-wrap: pretty, measure 34em.

body.purpose: All UI copy, option rows, statements, controls. Tabular lining figures are global here.

body-set.purpose: Quotations, citations, principles, prompts, the marginal excerpt; usually italic.

arabic.purpose: Qur'anic and hadith text in Amiri, dir=rtl, right-aligned, 1.95 line-height.

label.purpose: Rubric labels, state words, captions, source credits; uppercase and tracked.

runhead.purpose: The screen's rubric in the isnad strip, cinnabar, uppercase 0.16em.

folio.purpose: The NN — NN step counter; tabular, current step in full ink.

figure.purpose: The final score on the result screen, Literata 34px tabular.

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system; every transition and the excerpt entrance use it.

motion.name: duration-house
motion.purpose: The only duration; transitions, the excerpt entrance, and the scripted scroll glide.

motion.name: slide-in
motion.value: @keyframes slide-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-34px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
motion.purpose: The signature one-axis entrance of the margin excerpt and of revealed answer sheets. Never played in reverse.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: Hand-animated scroll correction after a check, because behavior:'smooth' is silently unreliable in embedded webviews.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Drops the entrance and the gauge transition and clamps all transitions.

components.name: Colophon Forward Action
components.description: The one lamp on the screen: the single live action, in the fixed full-bleed colophon.
components.css: .ds-colophon { display: flex; align-items: stretch; background: var(--night, #0B1E2E); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-act-back, .ds-act-go { background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; padding: 19px 14px; letter-spacing: .05em; transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-act-back { color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); min-width: 92px; padding-left: 0; text-align: left; } .ds-act-back:hover { color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); } .ds-act-go { flex: 1; color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); text-align: center; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; } .ds-act-go:hover { background: var(--night-raise, #0F2838); } .ds-act-go:focus-visible, .ds-act-back:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--lamp, #F9BC81); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Check Button
components.description: The amber-ruled «Проверить» action; disables itself once the answer has been checked.
components.css: .ds-btn-check { display: block; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; background: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--rule-lamp, rgba(249,188,129,.34)); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-check:hover { background: var(--night-raise, #0F2838); border-color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); } .ds-btn-check:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--lamp, #F9BC81); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-check[disabled] { border-color: var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); cursor: default; background: none; }

components.name: Option Row (single choice)
components.description: A ruled list row with a hairline-stroked dot; the verdict adds a word label flush right, never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-option-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, rgba(239,230,214,.07)); padding: 14px 2px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; position: relative; transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-option:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); } .ds-option:hover { background: var(--night-raise, #0F2838); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--lamp, #F9BC81); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dot { width: 13px; height: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3, #74898A); border-radius: 50%; transition: border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-option.ds-selected .ds-dot { border-color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--lamp, #F9BC81); } .ds-option.ds-correct { color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); } .ds-option.ds-correct .ds-dot { border-color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--dome, #5E9A6E); } .ds-option.ds-correct::after { content: 'верно'; margin-left: auto; padding-left: 10px; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); } .ds-option.ds-wrong { color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); } .ds-option.ds-wrong .ds-dot { border-color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--rubric, #D4764A); } .ds-option.ds-wrong::after { content: 'ваш выбор'; margin-left: auto; padding-left: 10px; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); }

components.name: Verdict Pair (true / false)
components.description: Two equal hairline-ruled buttons; right goes dome with a drawn tick, wrong goes cinnabar with a line-through.
components.css: .ds-tf { display: flex; gap: 9px; font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tf-btn { flex: 1; padding: 9px 10px; background: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); border-radius: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--ink-2, #A8B8B0); transition: border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tf-btn:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); } .ds-tf-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--lamp, #F9BC81); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tf-btn.ds-chosen { border-color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); } .ds-tf-btn.ds-right { border-color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); } .ds-tf-btn.ds-wrong { border-color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-mk { display: inline-flex; vertical-align: -2px; width: 13px; height: 13px; margin-left: 5px; } .ds-mk svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: The ordering field: the only element with a tonal body, a 2px radius, and a drawn caret.
components.html: <select class="ds-select"><option>1. Намерение</option><option>2. Пост</option></select><select class="ds-select ds-select-correct"><option>2. Пост</option></select>
components.css: .ds-select { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 11px 12px; background-color: var(--night-raise, #0F2838); color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14.5px; appearance: none; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--ink-3, #74898A) 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink-3, #74898A) 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 17px) 50%, calc(100% - 12px) 50%; background-size: 5px 5px, 5px 5px; background-repeat: no-repeat; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); } .ds-select:focus-visible { border-color: var(--lamp, #F9BC81); outline: none; } .ds-select.ds-select-correct { border-color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); color: var(--dome, #5E9A6E); } .ds-select.ds-select-wrong { border-color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); }

components.name: Band
components.description: The container idiom that replaces the card: two hairlines, no sides, no fill, no radius, no shadow.
components.html:
وَتَزَوَّدُوا فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوَى

«Берите с собой провизию, но, поистине, лучшая провизия — богобоязненность»

Сура Аль-Бакара
components.css: .ds-band { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); padding: 16px 0; margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-quote-ar { font-family: var(--ar, Amiri, serif); font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.95; direction: rtl; text-align: right; color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-quote-ru { font-family: var(--set, Literata, Georgia, serif); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; font-style: italic; color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); margin: 0; } .ds-quote-src { font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Isnad Strip and Gauge
components.description: The running head: attribution chain, the screen's rubric in cinnabar, a tabular folio counter, and a 1px gauge that is the entire progress indicator.
components.html:
шейх Мухаммад Ад-Дубейси → устаз Ибрахим Братов → Ша'бан

Подготовка

0414
components.css: .ds-isnad { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 16px; padding: 14px 0 8px; font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-chain { grid-column: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #74898A); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-runhead { grid-column: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); font-weight: 500; min-height: 1.5em; } .ds-folio { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; margin: 0; align-self: center; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ink-2, #A8B8B0); } .ds-folio-now { color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); } .ds-folio-rule { width: 14px; height: 1px; background: var(--rule, rgba(239,230,214,.14)); display: block; } .ds-gauge { height: 1px; background: var(--rule-soft, rgba(239,230,214,.07)); position: relative; } .ds-gauge-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--lamp-deep, #B57135); transform: scaleX(.28); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }

components.name: Margin Excerpt
components.description: The signature component: after a check, the lecture's own words enter the margin on one axis, tied to the answered row by a hairline, and never leave.
components.html:
Выдержка из текста

Ша'бан — месяц, в котором сердце готовят к Рамадану, а не месяц, в котором его торопят.
components.css: .ds-excerpt { margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 14px 0 14px 15px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-lamp, rgba(249,188,129,.34)); position: relative; animation: ds-slide-in 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-excerpt::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -22px; width: 1px; height: 22px; background: var(--rule-lamp, rgba(249,188,129,.34)); } .ds-excerpt-label { font-family: var(--app, 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); margin: 0 0 7px; } .ds-excerpt-text { font-family: var(--set, Literata, Georgia, serif); font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.62; font-style: italic; color: var(--ink, #EFE6D6); margin: 0; } @keyframes ds-slide-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-34px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (min-width: 900px) { .ds-excerpt { margin-top: 0; padding: 0 0 0 18px; } .ds-excerpt::before { left: -44px; top: 0; width: 44px; height: 1px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-excerpt { animation: none; } }

components.name: Drawn Marks
components.description: The whole icon set: eight marks drawn on a 24px box at a single 1.3 stroke weight, inheriting currentColor. No glyphs, no icon font.
components.css: .ds-marks { display: flex; gap: 14px; color: var(--rubric, #D4764A); } .ds-marks span { display: block; width: 26px; height: 26px; } .ds-marks svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Zaaduna is a page from a classical treatise. One column of set text runs down the left; the lecture's own words sit in the margin beside the line they answer, joined by a hairline. The ground — paper by day, near-black by night — is flat. Everything else is ink, rule and rubric, carried by two colours: navy leads, gold draws the lines. The boat on the logo gives the pairing, hull in gold under navy sails.
keyCharacteristics: Two colours and a neutral scale; a third hue is a defect, including green for right and red for wrong.
Gold draws, fills and frames; it never spells. Gold text on the page ground fails contrast at about 3:1.
Light is the base; dark arrives from prefers-color-scheme, and a switch in the header overrides the system.
One flat ground: no fills behind blocks, no gradients, no shadows anywhere.
The source excerpt is the signature component — the lecture's own words beside the answered row.
A verdict is never colour alone: a navy fill with a tick and a word, or a gold frame with a cross and a word.
The dhow appears as the cursor while reading and as the course-progress boat; clicking is left to the system pointer.
rules: The Two Colour Rule. Navy and gold, plus neutrals.
The Gold Is A Line Rule. Gold draws, fills and frames; it does not spell.
The Never Colour Alone Rule. Correct is a navy fill and a tick and the word; wrong is a gold frame and a cross and the word, with the correct answer still marked beside it.
The Flat Field Rule. The only permitted tonal shift is navy-tint as hover or field body.
The Hairline Separation Rule. Inside a chapter, blocks are separated by a 1px rule and a rubric label, never by a card or a fill.
The One Frame Rule. A four-sided hairline frame is reserved for the cycle on the contents page and goes nowhere else.
The Three Voices Rule. Literata is the text, Golos Text is the apparatus, Amiri is the Arabic.
The Running-Head Rubric Rule. A screen's rubric belongs in the running head; nothing is set above a heading in the text column.
The Tabular Figure Rule. Counters, scores and step numbers must not shift width as they change.
The Eleven Pixel Floor. Functional text a reader clicks is never set below 11px.
The Margin Excerpt Rule. After a check, the lecture's own words appear beside the answered row and never close.
The Proper Noun Rule. Running text is hyphenated by dictionary; names, headings, uppercase apparatus and Arabic are not.
dos: Let a block earn its boundary from a 1px rule and a small rubric label.
Use navy for anything a reader acts on, and let weight and placement carry rank.
Pair every signal colour with a glyph and a word.
Keep figures tabular so counters and scores sit still.
Set the lecture's own words in italic Literata so they read as quotation, not as commentary.
Declare a plain url() cursor before image-set(), so a browser that cannot parse the second keeps the first.
Give a small target its own padding rather than trusting the line box.
State the theme on <html> before first paint, so the page cannot flash the wrong ground.
Keep the konspekt light always: it is printed.
donts: Don't introduce a third hue, and never green for right or red for wrong.
Don't set gold as text on the page ground.
Don't introduce a filled panel or a boxed question; the one frame belongs to the cycle on the contents page.
Don't add a shadow; the system has no shadow vocabulary.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading in the text column.
Don't hide the source behind a 'show explanation' control.
Don't let the custom cursor do the pointing; the system pointer aims better.
Don't set functional text below 11px, inside a footer or anywhere else.
Don't hyphenate a personal name, a heading, or Arabic.
Don't let a progress scale promise a cycle that does not exist yet.
